first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence suggests signup simplification and shorter onboarding can improve early activation and time-to-value. I would verify those records before committing, while guarding against lower-quality signups or weaker downstream qualification.

final.rationale: Run a small guarded test of a shorter onboarding flow, prioritizing self-serve SMB accounts where activation and completion are currently weakening. The verified evidence shows stronger completion and retention gains from shortening onboarding, while signup simplification delivered only a modest qualified-revenue lift and a 1% retention decline. Monitor activation, time-to-value, 30-day retention, and qualified revenue before scaling.
